verdicts.reason: A rearranges the design into a real banner: a large, readable two-line headline on the left and the cat illustration on the right, which keeps its proportions and bleeds off the bottom edge as in the original. Its only flaw is minor: the cat group is cramped against the right edge, with a much smaller margin than the headline has on the left. B is just a shrunk, centred copy of the portrait layout: the headline is tiny and loses its dominance, the cats are small, and the left and right thirds of the banner are left as dead purple space.
